# datapip.de

> Philipp Jäckle — freelance digital analyst specialising in privacy-focused
> tracking, tag management and data layer implementation. Based in Germany,
> working in German and English.

The site is bilingual. Every page exists under /de/ and /en/; the German and
English URLs use different slugs and are linked by hreflang.

## What is offered

- Tracking debugging — auditing existing implementations, finding the cause of
  broken or missing data, fixing data layer, tag firing and consent logic.
- Tracking setup — client-side, server-side or cookieless, including consent
  management platform integration.
- Free browser-based tools, listed below.

## Free tools

- [Cookie scanner](https://datapip.de/en/cookie-crawler/): loads a URL on the
  server and reports which cookies, storage entries and requests occur BEFORE
  any consent decision. Optionally clicks a consent button and reports what
  consent changed. German: https://datapip.de/de/cookie-scanner/
- [De-coder](https://datapip.de/en/de-coder/): encode/decode URL and Base64,
  hash with MD5 or SHA-1/256/512, format JSON and querystrings. Runs entirely
  in the browser. German: https://datapip.de/de/de-kodierer/

## Paid products

- [Braze sGTM proxy](https://datapip.de/en/products/braze-sgtm-proxy/): a
  server-side Google Tag Manager client template that serves the Braze Web SDK
  from a first-party domain.
- [Shopify GA4 and Google Ads setup](https://datapip.de/en/products/shopify-gtm-setup/):
  a pre-built Shopify Custom Pixel plus GTM web container.

## Legal and privacy

- Imprint: https://datapip.de/en/imprint/ (German: /de/impressum/)
- Privacy policy: https://datapip.de/en/privacy/ (German: /de/datenschutz/)

The site sets no cookies of its own. Analytics is self-hosted, cookieless
Umami served from the site's own subdomain, so no third-party request is made
on any page.
